items.html: And behold, afterward the illumination of the upper light came out through the eyes, and clothed from half of the Tifferet of Adam Kadmon and below, and became the world of Nekudim. And the essential light, which is the root, remained within. And it was already explained that the circles of the Nekudim are what come out first, and in their encircling around the NHY of Adam Kadmon, they also surround beneath his straight feet; and they interposed between beneath his feet and the externality, which are Beriah and Yetzirah that descended there as mentioned, and drove them out from there, and they found no place. And they raised these two discernments of the externality to their place above, in the back of these Nekudim.
